verdict.rationale: Instinct's core interface is natural language: per its docs there are no new interfaces, you simply text or call it, and even revoking access can start with a conversation. Hands-on reviewers confirm operating it through iMessage requests that it carries out, such as making calls and sending back confirmations. Missing for 10: some controls still require the settings UI rather than conversation (training opt-out, deleting indexed data, after a tester's chat request to delete Gmail records went unhonored), and first-party documentation is thin marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: there are no new interfaces. It's trained to use a phone and a computer. You can text or call it.
You may revoke access by initiating a conversation with the Instinct agent
Several times he asked in iMessage, Instinct made the call, and the confirmation arrived in the same chat.
